title: The loop condition decides which middle slow stops on in an even list
caption: slow moves 1, fast moves 2; the loop stops when fast can't take another double step.

frames.text: Odd length (5 nodes): fast stops on the last node and slow on 30, the one true middle. Both loop conditions give the same answer.
Even length (4 nodes), `while fast and fast.next`: fast runs off the end (None) and slow stops on 30, the second middle.

Same list, `while fast.next and fast.next.next`: fast stops on 30 because it can't jump two more, and slow stops on 20, the first middle. That is the last node of the first half, which is what you want before a split.
